description: Add database migration, domain types, store interface, and PostgreSQL implementation for finding status management. This feature creates the sbom_finding_statuses table with its audit log companion table, adds the corresponding Go domain types, extends the SBOMStore interface with CRUD methods for finding statuses, and implements them in PostgresSBOMStore.
steps: Create migration file migrations/000032_create_sbom_finding_statuses.up.sql with: (1) sbom_finding_statuses table (id BIGINT GENERATED ALWAYS AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY, version_id BIGINT NOT NULL REFERENCES sbom_versions(id) ON DELETE CASCADE, vuln_id TEXT NOT NULL, purl TEXT NOT NULL, status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'open' CHECK (status IN ('open','in_triage','suppressed','false_positive','risk_accepted','resolved')), justification TEXT, updated_by BIGINT REFERENCES users(id), updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT NOW(), expires_at TIMESTAMPTZ, UNIQUE(version_id, vuln_id, purl)). (2) sbom_finding_status_log table for audit trail (id BIGINT GENERATED ALWAYS AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY, finding_status_id BIGINT NOT NULL REFERENCES sbom_finding_statuses(id) ON DELETE CASCADE, old_status TEXT NOT NULL, new_status TEXT NOT NULL, justification TEXT, changed_by BIGINT REFERENCES users(id), changed_at TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT NOW()). (3) Appropriate indexes on version_id, status, and vuln_id columns.
Create migration file migrations/000032_create_sbom_finding_statuses.down.sql that drops sbom_finding_status_log first, then sbom_finding_statuses.

Add domain types in internal/sbommon/sbommon.go: FindingStatus struct (ID int64, VersionID int64, VulnID string, Purl string, Status string, Justification string, UpdatedBy int64, UpdatedAt time.Time, ExpiresAt *time.Time) and FindingStatusLog struct (ID int64, FindingStatusID int64, OldStatus string, NewStatus string, Justification string, ChangedBy int64, ChangedAt time.Time). Also add FindingStatus constants: FindingStatusOpen, FindingStatusInTriage, FindingStatusSuppressed, FindingStatusFalsePositive, FindingStatusRiskAccepted, FindingStatusResolved.

Extend the SBOMStore interface in internal/sbommon/store.go with methods: UpsertFindingStatus(ctx context.Context, fs *FindingStatus) (*FindingStatus, error), GetFindingStatus(ctx context.Context, versionID int64, vulnID string, purl string) (*FindingStatus, error), ListFindingStatuses(ctx context.Context, versionID int64, statusFilter []string) ([]*FindingStatus, error), ListFindingStatusLog(ctx context.Context, findingStatusID int64) ([]*FindingStatusLog, error).

Implement the new interface methods in internal/sbommon/postgres.go. UpsertFindingStatus should use INSERT ... ON CONFLICT (version_id, vuln_id, purl) DO UPDATE, log the status change to sbom_finding_status_log when the status actually changes, and return the upserted record.
Update the mockSBOMStore in internal/sbommon/handlers_test.go to implement the new interface methods (store findingStatuses in a map, implement CRUD logic).
Add unit tests in internal/sbommon/store_test.go for the mock store covering UpsertFindingStatus, GetFindingStatus, ListFindingStatuses, and ListFindingStatusLog.
Update .kiro/steering/erd.md to add the new sbom_finding_statuses and sbom_finding_status_log tables and their relationships to the existing SBOM domain diagram.
acceptance_criteria: Migration 000032 up and down SQL files exist and are syntactically valid
FindingStatus and FindingStatusLog domain types are defined in sbommon.go
SBOMStore interface includes the four new methods
PostgresSBOMStore implements all new interface methods (compiles without error)
mockSBOMStore implements all new interface methods (compiles without error)
Unit tests for mock store pass covering upsert, get, list, and log operations
